items.text: Opening motion contract: every camera move must have a narrative function, a visible origin, and a destination or consequence. Use the project catalog deliberately: CAM-APPROACH commits to a subject through nonlinear parallax rather than digital zoom; CAM-ASCENT reveals a formation; CAM-ORBIT changes the relationship between a subject and surrounding evidence; CAM-ATTENTION-HANDOFF transfers agency between Them 1, Them 2, a note parcel, or a puzzle consequence; CAM-SUSTAINED-REFRAME must arrive on a meaningful anchor instead of drifting. Preserve continuity at adjacent cue boundaries, and use EDIT-CONTEXT-REFRESH at lyric or arrangement turns before a frame context grows stale. No opening background may become an inert backdrop. At all times maintain at least two independently moving depth systems selected from cropped drum rings, bass horizons, exact-note bodies, backing-vocal contour echoes, rust planetary striations, bowed river currents, recursive leaf veins, offscreen fragments, star motes, or dust. Give those systems unequal speeds, arcs, scales, phases and musical drivers so they read as FRAME-PERIPHERAL-COUNTERPOINT rather than synchronized wallpaper. Use ANIM-MULTIPLANE, DEPTH-MOTION-PARALLAX, DEPTH-DYNAMIC-OCCLUSION and DEPTH-EDGE-CROSSING to make the camera movement legible. A deliberate void is allowed only for absence, anticipation, a missing fit, or an attention handoff. Even then, use FRAME-NEGATIVE-WAKE: surrounding lines should curve around it, and sparse star or dust particles should continue through several depths with ANIM-CYCLE-VARIATION and a slow bass/master drift. Do not fill the void's storytelling centre or let auxiliary motion compete with the featured action. Held performers use ANIM-MOVING-HOLD, line boil, gaze, breath and unequal follow-through; nothing freezes merely because the foreground pose is held.

items.text: Frame-context pacing rule: treat roughly eight seconds in one camera/compositional context as a review checkpoint and twelve seconds as the ordinary ceiling without a major introduction or renewal, unless a deliberately sustained moving hold serves the story. A meaningful refresh changes at least two of camera angle, shot scale, screen axis, depth composition, dominant entrant, or foreground/background hierarchy, and should align with an identifiable lyric, phrase, speaker, or arrangement event. Local object animation, glow, or amplitude changes alone do not reset the frame context. In the inspection scene, “I see the world plus more” is the authored pivot from high-oblique table analysis to a low three-quarter orbit with the grid as horizon and the world construction right of centre.

items.text: Current visual direction for the introduction into the psychedelic garden: treat the entrance and chorus as one uninterrupted forward dolly through genuine perspective depth, and make the percussion the architecture rather than a small central object. Broad solid-color annuli, radial planes, and background washes should fill the image like a curved time tunnel while large abstract swirls enter from beyond the image, crop through it, and leave again. Foliage perpetually grows in discrete recursive generations, but no stalk may appear to begin at a visibly cut bottom: extend a curved source tail in the opposite direction, change its width and glow to suggest bending toward or away from camera, and fade the continuation before its terminal point so the organism feels larger than the frame. Use classic drawn-animation grammar deliberately—clear key poses, anticipation, unequal slow-in/out, follow-through, moving holds, occasional smears, cycle variation, and multiplane staging. Combine vector-compatible depth cues instead of atmospheric washout: near contours should knock out the colored layers beneath them, foreground scale must accelerate faster, parallax and dynamic occlusion should reveal and conceal background marks, and projected size should control line weight, glow, and recursive detail. Broad visual mass follows slower beat/phrase followers; only narrow contour displacement retains the actual audio-rate waveform for temporal supersampling. The face-on lead is the featured performer: keep her larger and brighter than the ensemble, rise quickly with vocal energy, hold through brief gaps between words, release slowly after the connected phrase, and continue swelling during sustained delivery instead of hitting a fixed maximum immediately. Give her dance-like rocking and bopping plus occasional full-roll punctuation. Use exact MIDI notes selectively, never as a permanent piano roll: chosen Diva notes become curved seed or moon actors whose note-on determines contact, duration determines elongation, pitch determines trajectory and color, and velocity determines bloom. Treat every major element as an entity with authored interaction beats rather than simulated physics: name an initiator and responder, choreograph approach, deformation or accommodation, contact, unequal recoil, and follow-through, and let the camera or another actor inherit attention afterward.

items.text: Current visual direction for the Mars production: preserve the accepted content timing and seven shot boundaries, but use the established face-on eyes and phonetic mouth as the complete performer vocabulary—no anatomical chorus doodles, head circles, or constructed bodies. Large featured faces swell, hold and rock with the vocal; camera-addressing chorus faces perform deliberate scale and phonetic waves while their positions create Berkeley rings, spirals, diagonals, processions and nested excavation patterns. Mars is not an outlined circle with small marks inside it: infer a dimensional transforming world from an occluding dark mass, broad clipped color rivers, rotating great-circle ribbons and a small open three-arm curl, with no perimeter line or closed eye symbol. Exact Diva notes are travelling actors throughout the section: pitch class uses the shared twelve-color palette, absolute pitch sets the vertical lane, duration sets trail length, onset creates the moving luminous head, and stable secondary depth determines whether a trail crosses behind or in front of the formation. Keep peripheral face activity entering and leaving through the frame edges, and preserve the existing camera pacing while making the artwork and internal motion substantially richer.
